status_statement: This document is a versioned, explicitly PROPOSED source-specific machine-readable field contract for the registered UCI-412 (DA-A1) 16-feature basic clinical panel, intended as a technical handoff for future application and OCR development. It is not an approved clinical intake contract, not a model input schema that auto-populates patient data, not a harmonized cross-dataset schema, not a dataset-selection decision, not model training or inference authorization, and not supervisor, ethics or institutional approval. The companion validator accepts SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE FIXTURES ONLY, never reads any dataset file, is offline, and never computes a CAD probability. Gate PT P-3 remains CLOSED; P-1 remains PENDING; P-5 remains NOT MADE - prohibited. No mapping in this contract authorizes auto-population of model inputs from patient documents.

governance_context.d047: Cleveland-only internal exploratory benchmark; saved no reusable research model for this source
governance_context.d048_m3a: UCI-412-only internal exploratory benchmark; PROPOSED; no real-data run authorized by this contract
governance_context.relationship_to_frozen_protocols: This contract modifies no frozen protocol, registered plan, feature dictionary (uci412_research_feature_dictionary 1.1.0), runner, adapter or result. research/uci412/** and ai/diagnostic_scope.py are untouched. It documents the already-registered da_a1_basic_clinical_v1 panel; it admits no new predictor.
governance_context.a3_diagnostic_registry: The ratified A3 Cleveland diagnostic registry and its exact-revision, HMAC/NTFS and offline-authorization guards are separate and are not extended, replaced or bypassed by this UCI-412 contract.

registered_source.source_title: Z-Alizadeh Sani (UCI Machine Learning Repository, id 412)
registered_source.independence_statement: UCI-411 is the same 303 participants and is never an independent cohort or a validation set for UCI-412.

panel_binding.amendment: M3A-AMENDMENT-A1 (numeric 0/1 source encoding for six admitted binary columns)
panel_binding.field_order_statement: The 16 columns are an ordered allowlist. A payload that supplies the same set in a different order is rejected; access is positional after name-based validation and the order is bound to the panel contract SHA-256.

target_binding.target_definition: Cross-sectional angiographic CAD presence: Cath='Cad' means diameter narrowing greater than or equal to 50% in at least one major coronary artery; 'Normal' otherwise.
target_binding.non_equivalence_statement: UCI-412 uses a >=50% boundary. UCI-45/Cleveland uses a >50% boundary (num 0 vs 1-4). The two targets are related-but-not-identical and are never treated as equivalent, pooled, or cross-walked. Exactly-50% records cannot be identified in either released file (visual estimate, categorical release).
target_binding.outcome_construct: Cross-sectional angiography-referenced CAD presence in a referral cohort. Never a 30-day or future cardiovascular event horizon and never a clinical risk score.

channels.definition: A structured, clinician- or patient-entered historical field in the future application (demographics, risk-factor history, reported symptoms). No document OCR involved.
A value recorded directly by a clinician during assessment (symptom characterization or examination finding).
A measured vital sign or anthropometric value entered as a structured measurement with an explicit unit.
A value extracted from a laboratory report document. For this 16-feature panel no field is laboratory-sourced; routine labs belong to the separately blocked da_a1_clinical_core_labs_v1 panel.

global_rules: VERIFIED_REGISTERED_SOURCE_DOMAIN means the channel matches the source_domain/input_owner already recorded in the frozen feature dictionary 1.1.0; it verifies the dataset's recorded domain, not any future application screen or OCR pipeline.
Every future-application or OCR acquisition mapping is PROPOSED_FUTURE_ACQUISITION_CHANNEL. None is verified against an owner codebook and none authorizes auto-population.
OCR-derived patient-document input is rejected by the synthetic executor in this milestone; an OCR channel may only be listed as a proposed future channel, never as a confirmed source.
Wearable / Track B / patient-monitoring streams are prohibited for every field and have no proposed channel here.
No silent unit conversion is permitted; a measured value must carry the exact registered unit token or be rejected.

prediction_time_evidence.statement: The UCI-412 landing page and accessible owner literature state no per-field acquisition time. EXPECTED_AVAILABLE_BEFORE_ANGIOGRAPHY is an inference from feature group and clinical workflow, not a documented pre-angiography prediction moment (Gate PT doc 15, U-6: UNRESOLVED). Any future intake must treat prediction-time availability as unverified.

prohibited_acquisition.track_b_wearable: Wearable, patient-monitoring and Track B streams are prohibited for every field and are rejected.
prohibited_acquisition.ocr_auto_population: OCR-derived patient-document values are not an accepted acquisition source in this milestone. Any future OCR channel is PROPOSED only and must never auto-populate a model input without separate human authorization and a verified per-field extraction contract.
prohibited_acquisition.post_angiography_fields: Cath, LAD, LCX, RCA, echocardiography (EF-TTE, Region RWMA, VHD), identifiers and administrative fields are outcome-derived, post-outcome or prohibited and are absent from this contract.
prohibited_acquisition.cross_source_fields: UCI-45/Cleveland fields (age, sex, cp, trestbps, restecg, ...) are other-dataset sources and are rejected; no crosswalk exists.

missingness_policy.record_level_rule: All 16 fields are required (non-null) in a validated da_a1_basic_clinical_v1 record; the panel declares no optional fields.
missingness_policy.training_rule: If a blank is ever encountered it is NaN and is imputed strictly inside a training fold, with a missingness indicator; no global imputation or value repair is performed.

no_result_contract.statement: This contract and its validator never compute, return or imply a CAD probability, risk score, diagnosis, or threshold decision. It validates field provenance and coding only.

unresolved_question_register.question: Exact delivered text tokens for the six text-binary columns (incl. Sex 'Fmale') are unverified against an owner codebook.
BP measured quantity (systolic/diastolic/single) and measurement conditions are undocumented; unit mmHg is secondary-source.
PR unit token ('ppm' vs beats/min) is owner-unconfirmed; measurement conditions undocumented.
Chest-pain flag mutual exclusivity and elicitation definitions are undocumented.
Numeric 0/1 direction (0=absent, 1=present) for six columns is secondary-literature supported, not owner-codebook verified; requires explicit human acceptance.
Per-field acquisition time relative to angiography is undocumented for all 16 fields; pre-angiography availability is workflow inference only.
UCI-412 >=50% vs UCI-45 >50% target boundary differs; exactly-50% records are unidentifiable; disposition is related-but-not-identical.
